title: Three steps, not another app.

memory.title: WH3RE finds the places you and your friends already know.
memory.text: Bookings in your emails, shared places, answers from your friends. Nothing read behind your back.

ask.title: You ask a question the way you’d ask a friend.
ask.text: “A hidden spot, not too loud, for tonight.” WH3RE gets the context.

answers.title: You get a few explained answers, not an endless list.
answers.text: Three solid ideas, with who recommends them and why.

promise: Ask your network without asking everyone.
promiseText: Instead of digging through hundreds of anonymous reviews or sending the same question to five WhatsApp groups.
